title: VIP Chapter 2 Week 1: Geology of Ethiopia and the Horn

questions.text: Which is an ENDOGENIC process?
questions.explanation: Volcanism comes from INSIDE the Earth (endogenic). Others are exogenic.

questions.text: Erta Ale volcano in Ethiopia is which type of feature?
questions.explanation: Volcanoes are created by ENDOGENIC forces (magma from within Earth).

questions.text: The Blue Nile Gorge was carved by which process?
questions.explanation: The Blue Nile River eroded the gorge over millions of years (exogenic process).

questions.text: Which dating method gives EXACT age?
questions.explanation: Absolute dating (radiometric) gives exact age in years. Others are relative.

questions.text: Potassium-Argon dating is BEST for:
questions.explanation: K-Ar dating works on volcanic rocks millions of years old.

questions.text: The principle of CROSS-CUTTING says:
options: A) Faults are OLDER than rocks they cut
B) Faults are YOUNGER than rocks they cut
C) All rocks are same age
questions.correct_answer: B) Faults are YOUNGER than rocks they cut
questions.explanation: A fault/intrusion must be younger than the rocks it cuts through.

questions.text: Which era is known for DINOSAURS?
questions.explanation: Mesozoic (252-66 million years ago) = Age of Dinosaurs.

questions.text: The Cenozoic era is known as the age of:
questions.explanation: Cenozoic = Age of Mammals (66 million years ago to present).

questions.text: Ethiopian Rift Valley is evidence of:
questions.explanation: Rift Valley = tectonic forces pulling crust apart (endogenic).

questions.text: Weathering breaks rocks through:
options: B) Temperature changes and chemical reactions (external)
questions.correct_answer: B) Temperature changes and chemical reactions (external)
questions.explanation: Weathering = exogenic process from atmosphere/water.

questions.text: Mass wasting is caused by:
questions.explanation: Mass wasting = downslope movement of rocks/soil due to GRAVITY.

questions.text: Carbon-14 dating CANNOT date:
options: B) Dinosaur bones (millions of years old)
questions.correct_answer: B) Dinosaur bones (millions of years old)
questions.explanation: Carbon-14 only works up to ~50,000 years. Dinosaurs are millions of years old.

questions.text: Which is the LONGEST geological era?
questions.explanation: Precambrian = 4.6 billion to 541 million years ago (~88% of Earth history).

questions.text: Ethiopia's highlands were formed by:
questions.explanation: Highlands = result of tectonic UPLIFT (endogenic).

questions.text: Relative dating uses ALL EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: Radiometric decay = ABSOLUTE dating. Others are relative methods.

questions.text: Glacial erosion creates:
questions.explanation: Glaciers carve U-shaped valleys (rivers create V-shaped).

questions.text: Wind erosion is most effective in:
questions.explanation: Wind erosion works best in DRY areas with loose sand and little vegetation.

questions.text: The Dallol depression in Ethiopia is known for:
questions.explanation: Dallol = volcanic area with hot springs, mineral deposits (endogenic).

questions.text: Which process BUILDS UP the Earth's surface?
questions.explanation: Uplift (endogenic) RAISES land. Erosion/weathering wear it down.

questions.text: The study of rock layers (stratigraphy) is used for:
questions.explanation: Stratigraphy studies rock layers to determine relative ages.
